name: Do comfort height toilets require special plumbing considerations?

mainEntity.name: Do comfort height toilets require special plumbing considerations?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, comfort height toilets do not require special plumbing considerations beyond what a standard toilet would. They connect to the same water supply line and waste pipe. The primary difference is the height of the bowl, which doesn't alter the basic plumbing connections. However, if you are replacing an older toilet or if your existing plumbing has issues, minor adjustments or repairs might be necessary to ensure a leak-free and secure installation. We always inspect existing plumbing during our assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, comfort height toilets generally use the same plumbing connections as standard toilets; however, existing plumbing issues may require minor adjustments.
